title: matplotlib: figure, axes, and a chart worth publishing

videos.script: Three lines of matplotlib draw a chart. {{three}} It has a line, two axes and some numbers, and it answers one question. What is in this column? {{default}} Nobody you send it to asked that. {{nobody}} A chart worth sending answers a different question, and its title says which. {{title}} The thin line is the noise. The thick line is the point. The axis says what is counted. {{layers}} This lesson builds charts like that, one call at a time, on a Figure and the Axes inside it. {{figure}} On the way it meets three mistakes that look finished. Bars on an axis that does not start at zero. Names cut off at the edge of the file you saved. Two charts side by side on two different scales. {{mistakes}} Each one fails in silence. Each one has a one-line fix. {{end}}
